summary: The TypeScript 7.0.2 root export is version metadata; maintained declaration scripts use unstable/sync API and unstable/ast through a shared projection adapter. One native API per invocation serves a one-file virtual project with noResolve/noLib/types-empty and denied undeclared reads, leaving the existing resolver authoritative. Snapshots dispose after each callback and the API closes in finally. The published literal guard is isStringLiteralLikeNode. Reusing a virtual file requires both clearSourceFileCache and invalidateAll; the adapter refuses mismatched source text. Native moduleAugmentations includes identifier global, which is not a module edge; only string-literal augmentations join the cross-check. Tests cover replacement, refusal cleanup and references. The documented migration preserved Babylon/Pixi declaration and generated candidate bytes and Game curated binding hashes. Headless SwiftShader composition is distinct from hardware GPU, downstream adoption and publication. This extends the historical templates/fable-bindings-toolchain-contract snapshot; its recorded older pins remain historical evidence.
title: TypeScript 7 declaration parsing preserves bounded closure ownership
